_comment: 推荐：SSMS 跑 display.sql → 导出 display.xlsx。下面仅作可选直连数据库用。
query: SELECT w.Name AS WarehouseName, p.Sku, p.Name AS ProductName, SUM(s.Quantity) AS DisplayQty FROM Stocks s JOIN Warehouses w ON s.WarehouseId = w.Id JOIN Products p ON s.ProductId = p.Id WHERE w.Name LIKE '%Display%' AND p.IsDiscontinued = 0 GROUP BY w.Name, p.Sku, p.Name HAVING SUM(s.Quantity) > 0 ORDER BY w.Name, DisplayQty DESC
